name: md-studio
description: WYSIWYG Markdown editor with a bundled, configurable Mermaid and single-file HTML export. Works fully offline.

enumDescriptions: Use the Mermaid build bundled with the extension.
Use the mermaid.min.js file given in mdStudio.mermaid.file.
mdStudio.mermaid.source.markdownDescription: Which Mermaid build to use for the editor and HTML export.

mdStudio.mermaid.file.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a `mermaid.min.js` (IIFE build that defines `window.mermaid`) used when `#mdStudio.mermaid.source#` is `file`. On Remote-SSH / WSL this is a path on the remote machine. `~` and `${workspaceFolder}` are expanded.

mdStudio.mermaid.theme.markdownDescription: Default Mermaid theme. Empty = Mermaid's own default (Mermaid 12 uses `redux-color` for flowcharts). A `config:` block at the top of a diagram always wins.

mdStudio.mermaid.look.markdownDescription: Default Mermaid look. Empty = Mermaid's own default (Mermaid 12: `neo`).

mdStudio.mermaid.layout.markdownDescription: Default Mermaid layout engine. Empty = Mermaid's own default (Mermaid 12: `elk`).

mdStudio.mermaid.securityLevel.markdownDescription: Mermaid `securityLevel`. `loose` allows HTML labels. Use `strict` for untrusted documents.

mdStudio.mermaid.config.markdownDescription: Extra options passed to `mermaid.initialize()` (e.g. `{"flowchart": {"curve": "basis"}}`). Theme / look / layout above take precedence over the same keys here.

enumDescriptions: Word-like WYSIWYG: formatting is shown, Markdown symbols are hidden.
Instant rendering: Markdown symbols appear around the cursor (Typora-like).
Split view: source on the left, preview on the right.
mdStudio.editor.mode.markdownDescription: Editing mode of the WYSIWYG editor. Takes effect when the editor is reopened.

mdStudio.editor.outline.markdownDescription: Show the outline (table of contents) on the left when the editor opens. It can be toggled from the toolbar.

enumDescriptions: Same colors as the current VS Code color theme.
White page with a gray toolbar and outline.
Soft cream page, easy on the eyes.
Deeper beige, like an e-book reader.
Dark gray page.
Dark blue page.
mdStudio.editor.theme.markdownDescription: Color theme of the MD Studio editor. Can also be changed from the toolbar (Editor Theme button). Does not affect exports (see `#mdStudio.export.theme#`).

mdStudio.editor.readOnly.markdownDescription: Open Markdown files read-only: the document can be read, searched, copied and exported but not changed. Toggle per editor with the lock button on the toolbar or **MD Studio: Toggle Read-Only Mode**. Files on a read-only file system (e.g. the old side of a Git diff) are always read-only.

mdStudio.editor.allowRemoteImages.markdownDescription: Allow the editor to load `https:` images. Off by default so the editor never goes to the network.

mdStudio.plantuml.server.markdownDescription: PlantUML server used to draw ` ```plantuml ` blocks, e.g. `http://plantuml.example.local/plantuml` (the part before `/svg/...`). Empty = PlantUML blocks are not drawn. The diagram text is sent to this server; exports embed the returned SVG. Do not use a public server for confidential documents.

mdStudio.image.folder.markdownDescription: Folder (relative to the Markdown file) where pasted images are saved.

mdStudio.export.format.markdownDescription: Default format in the Export panel.

enumDescriptions: Embed images in the HTML as data URIs (one self-contained file).
Keep links to the original image files (paths rewritten relative to the HTML).
Copy images to a `<name>_files` folder next to the HTML.
mdStudio.export.images.markdownDescription: How images are written to exported HTML. PDF always embeds them.

mdStudio.export.highlight.markdownDescription: Syntax highlighting for code blocks in exports.

mdStudio.export.toc.markdownDescription: Table of contents in exported HTML.

mdStudio.export.tocDepth.markdownDescription: Heading levels listed in the table of contents (HTML and PDF).

mdStudio.export.tocTitle.markdownDescription: Title of the table of contents.

mdStudio.export.theme.markdownDescription: Color theme of exported HTML. `auto` follows the viewer's OS setting.

mdStudio.export.maxWidth.markdownDescription: Maximum width (px) of the body in exported HTML.

mdStudio.export.openAfter.markdownDescription: Open the exported file with its default application.

mdStudio.pdf.toc.markdownDescription: Start the PDF with a table of contents page (with page numbers and links).

mdStudio.pdf.bookmarks.markdownDescription: Add PDF bookmarks (outline) for the headings.

mdStudio.pdf.pageNumbers.markdownDescription: Page numbers (`n / total`) in the footer.

mdStudio.pdf.headerTitle.markdownDescription: Document title in the page header.

mdStudio.pdf.browserPath.markdownDescription: Browser used to print PDF (Edge, Chrome or Chromium). Empty = detect Microsoft Edge / Google Chrome automatically. On Remote-SSH / WSL this is a path on the remote machine.

mdStudio.update.source.markdownDescription: Where new versions are published: a folder with `md-studio-<version>.vsix` files (e.g. `\\\\server\\share\\md-studio`), or an intranet URL that serves `latest.json`. Empty = never check. On Remote-SSH / WSL the path is resolved on the remote machine.

enumDescriptions: Ask before installing a new version.
Install new versions without asking (a reload is still needed).
mdStudio.update.mode.markdownDescription: What to do when a newer version is found in `#mdStudio.update.source#`.

enumDescriptions: Same as the editor: VS Code's `markdown.preview.fontFamily`.
Yu Gothic (游ゴシック)
Meiryo (メイリオ)
BIZ UDPGothic (BIZ UDPゴシック)
Yu Mincho (游明朝)
BIZ UDPMincho (BIZ UDP明朝)
The font names in `mdStudio.export.fontCustom`.
mdStudio.export.font.markdownDescription: Text font of exported HTML and PDF. Code always uses `editor.fontFamily`.

mdStudio.export.fontCustom.markdownDescription: CSS font-family list used when `#mdStudio.export.font#` is `custom`, e.g. `"Noto Sans JP", Meiryo`.

mdStudio.pdf.fontSize.markdownDescription: Body text size of exported PDF, in points.
